versions.subject: Add new rules for detection msdt.exe create file to autorun
versions.detection:
selection:
    - Image|endswith: '\msdt.exe'
    - TargetFilename|contains: '\AppData\Roaming\Microsoft\Windows\Start Menu\Programs\Startup\' 
condition: selection
